rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md points new contributors to the read-only startup packet for canonical task contribute and to docs/agents/first-contribution.md. Its 'Pick or scope a research direction' row names the opportunity map and validates with opportunities and links. Add a short offline-first starting point under 'How to pick an opportunity': choose one proposal, write its source claim and falsifiable mechanism or hypothesis, and note needed capabilities and evidence gaps before installed-surface checks or any authorized campaign. The README and canonical onboarding route already allow offline work, but the opportunity guide currently begins with installed-surface verification and campaign protocol steps. Pre-edit baseline: the opportunities mode produced no findings; links reported 11 existing missing-target errors for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and legal/terms.md.
offline_access: The canonical contribute route is offline-allowed and needs only repository reading and local validators. Documentation and offline research do not require an invite code, wallet, installed OpenForage package, daemon, worker, or campaign; no service or live process is involved.
completion_criteria: Add one concise offline-first note to docs/agents/research-opportunities.md that helps scope a proposal before a live campaign, while keeping proposals distinct from results.
The opportunities validator passes; links introduces no findings beyond the 11 pre-edit missing-target errors for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and legal/terms.md.
git diff --check is clean for the eventual scoped change, and unrelated files are preserved.
All claims remain tied to the visible sources, evidence gaps stay explicit, and no live access or measured result is implied.
